text: Road tanker unloading station with 4 bays (metering, strainers, spill containment, earthing), and two vertical fixed-roof storage tanks each of 3,500 m3 net working volume (together 72 hours of base-load operation on LDO; heel and fire-fighting reserves in addition), in a bund of 110 % of the largest tank, with foam fire protection per NFPA 11 and NFPA 30, level/leak monitoring and water draw-off. Operation beyond the storage autonomy is not required (resupply is limited to 25 trucks/day).
title: LDO unloading and storage
